content.value_statement: Drug discovery teams need reliable choices among molecular datasets, graph models, and evaluation methods. This skill provides focused TorchDrug guidance for complete research workflows.
actual_capabilities: Selects TorchDrug datasets and graph models for molecular, protein, reaction, and knowledge-graph tasks.
Outlines training workflows for property prediction, protein modeling, knowledge-graph completion, molecular generation, and retrosynthesis.
Explains GIN, GAT, SchNet, GearNet, ESM, TransE, RotatE, and related architectures.
Provides examples for integrating TorchDrug with RDKit, AlphaFold structures, ESM, and PyTorch Lightning.
Recommends evaluation metrics, dataset splitting strategies, molecular validation, and common troubleshooting checks.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples but does not run experiments or verify local results.
TorchDrug, PyTorch, datasets, and optional scientific dependencies must be installed separately.
Generated molecules and synthesis routes require expert chemistry review and experimental validation.
API details can change, so users should confirm version-specific behavior in upstream documentation.

use_cases.title: Screen Molecular Properties
use_cases.description: Choose datasets, graph models, splits, and metrics for toxicity, solubility, activity, or blood-brain barrier prediction.

use_cases.title: Model Protein Function
use_cases.description: Plan sequence-based or structure-based protein workflows using ESM, GearNet, and appropriate protein datasets.

use_cases.title: Explore Biomedical Relationships
use_cases.description: Design knowledge-graph completion experiments for drug repurposing, disease mechanisms, and gene-disease association analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to predict {property} from {data_type}. Recommend a TorchDrug dataset, model, task, split, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Training Experiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TorchDrug experiment plan for {research_goal}. Include preprocessing, architecture, task configuration, training stages, validation, and expected failure checks.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a TorchDrug Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this TorchDrug issue: {symptoms}. Review dimensions, graph construction, splitting, metrics, memory use, and model suitability before proposing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Stage Discovery Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible TorchDrug pipeline for {objective}. Connect prediction, generation or retrosynthesis, multi-objective ranking, chemistry validation, and uncertainty analysis.

output_examples.input: Choose a workflow for blood-brain barrier prediction.
output_examples.output: Recommended workflow: use the BBBP dataset, a GIN molecular graph model, scaffold splitting, binary classification, AUROC, and AUPRC.

output_examples.input: Select a model for enzyme function prediction from sequences.
output_examples.output: Start with a pretrained ESM representation and compare it with GearNet when reliable protein structures are available.

output_examples.input: My generated molecules are often invalid.
output_examples.output: Add validity constraints during generation, validate structures with RDKit, filter drug-likeness, and report validity, uniqueness, and novelty separately.

best_practices: Use scaffold splits for molecular property tasks when realistic generalization matters.
Match model input dimensions and graph construction to dataset features before training.
Validate generated molecules and synthesis predictions with chemistry tools and domain experts.
anti_patterns: Do not compare models with inconsistent splits, preprocessing, or evaluation metrics.
Do not treat high benchmark scores as evidence of clinical or experimental validity.
Do not optimize generated molecules for one property without validity, synthesizability, and safety constraints.

faq.question: What is TorchDrug?
faq.answer: TorchDrug is a PyTorch-based toolbox for machine learning on molecules, proteins, reactions, and biomedical knowledge graphs.

faq.question: Does this skill install TorchDrug?
faq.answer: No. It provides installation guidance, but the user controls package installation and local environment configuration.

faq.question: Which molecular models are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers models including GIN, GAT, GCN, MPNN, SchNet, and GraphAutoregressiveFlow.

faq.question: Can it support protein tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers protein datasets, sequence models such as ESM, and structure models such as GearNet.

faq.question: Can predictions replace laboratory validation?
faq.answer: No. Predictions, generated molecules, and synthesis routes require scientific review and experimental validation.

faq.question: Does it cover knowledge graphs and retrosynthesis?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes knowledge-graph completion, biomedical link prediction, reaction-center identification, synthon completion, and multi-step planning concepts.
